source.title: Rise, Thunderfury!
source.description: You have defeated the Wind Seeker. Take the dormant blade and force the worshiper, Demitrian, to use the materials you provided to wake Thunderfury.
source.progress: <Demitrian is in awe of your presence.
source.completion: Your might will be carried eternally on the winds of Azeroth. Take the blade and sing your storm.
